# Face vs faceless

**Is a face on camera, and how much?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C28


## Expert on camera
<a id="face-expert"></a>

One person talking to camera; Oren's number-one strategy.

**Looks like:** You, looking into the lens, explaining. The face is the brand.

**Good at:** trust; follows; personality beats brand handles

**Weak at:** camera confidence; needs to be filmable

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals trust, follows · effort low

**How:** Tripod, plug-in mic, standard yap.

**Backed by:** [Three Instagram strategies](../topics/brand.md#brand-instagram-strategies), [Yap types: standard, walking, car](../topics/filming.md#film-yap-formats), [Faceless works if there's a concept](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-faceless-with-concept), [Face check before using any frame](../topics/editing.md#edit-face-check), [Captions on yaps for almost everybody](../topics/text.md#text-captions-on-yaps) · sources L07, L06, R1

## Face as a small cameo
<a id="face-cameo"></a>

The content fills the frame; the face sits in a corner circle or appears only for key lines.

**Looks like:** A screen demo with a ringed face circle reacting; full face only for the hook and the CTA.

**Good at:** tutorial clarity plus personality; recognition; face stays visible on screen content

**Weak at:** the face is small; two sources to sync

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches tech, gaming · goals saves, trust · effort medium

**How:** A CapCut circle mask over the content; film the face separately or with the screen capture.

**Backed by:** [Screen content with a circular face cam](../topics/editing.md#edit-screen-card-circle-facecam), [Face check before using any frame](../topics/editing.md#edit-face-check), [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face), [Faceless works if there's a concept](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-faceless-with-concept) · sources R1, L07

## Hands-only POV with voiceover
<a id="hands-pov"></a>

No face; POV hands doing the thing, with a voiceover and a concept.

**Looks like:** Top-down hands building a PC or loading plates, with a voiceover telling a mini story. Gel Blaster's POV skits hit 800,000 this way.

**Good at:** no camera nerves; satisfying visuals; concept-led reach

**Weak at:** needs a strong concept; slower recognition

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches tech, gym, gaming · goals reach, shares · effort medium

**How:** Overhead or chest-height phone mount; voiceover recorded separately in Edits.

**Backed by:** [Faceless works if there's a concept](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-faceless-with-concept), [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face), [Face check before using any frame](../topics/editing.md#edit-face-check), [Captions on yaps for almost everybody](../topics/text.md#text-captions-on-yaps) · sources L07

## Motion graphics only
<a id="graphics-only"></a>

Everything is animation and text, with or without voice.

**Looks like:** A dark background, an animated graph with a dotted trail, word-by-word captions. No camera footage at all.

**Good at:** explains abstract ideas; made at a desk; premium if done well

**Weak at:** no personal connection; heavy build time

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches tech · goals saves, shares · effort high

**How:** HyperFrames compositions; voiceover optional.

**Backed by:** [Make motion visible with a dotted trail](../topics/effects.md#fx-trail-visual-proof), [Faceless works if there's a concept](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-faceless-with-concept), [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face), [Frame low, leave headroom for graphics](../topics/filming.md#film-framed-graphic-headroom) · sources L03

## B-roll plus text, no voice
<a id="broll-text"></a>

Footage of the day or place with on-screen text and music; you appear but don't talk.

**Looks like:** A timestamped day: 6:00 alarm, 6:40 gym, 9:00 desk, each with a time label, cut to music. Or a travel dump with captions.

**Good at:** easy to film; vibe; trend formats

**Weak at:** less teaching; less voice-led trust

**Best for:** formats reel30, carousel, story · niches gym, travel · goals reach, shares · effort low

**How:** B-roll list per session; text plus trending audio in Edits.

**Backed by:** [Travel formats: vibe, dump, POV, "nobody tells you"](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-travel-formats), [Gym formats to rotate](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-gym-rotation-formats), [Gym B-roll every session](../topics/filming.md#film-gym-broll), [Faceless works if there's a concept](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-faceless-with-concept), [View-count pill on every example](../topics/effects.md#l11-view-count-proof-pill) · sources SP, research

## Mixing
Face for the hook and the CTA with faceless content in between is common (L01 and Rahul switch layouts). A cameo face is the middle ground.

## Rule of thumb
Trust and follows: face. Tutorials: cameo. Concept skits: hands POV. Abstract explainers: graphics only. Vibe: B-roll plus text.
